metadata.name: sra_handler
metadata.description: SRA Handler — bridge-agnostic, mint-agnostic source + destination handler

accounts.name: admin
docs: Receives the closed PDA's rent.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Receives the closed PDA's rent.

accounts.name: fee_payer
docs: Pays tx fees. Separated from `owner` to enable gas sponsorship.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Owns the source ATA and authorizes the user->vault transfer.

accounts.name: adapter_authority
docs: the derivation.

accounts.name: protocol_fee_config
docs: empty data == no fee for this app — existence is read in-body, never
caller-claimed.

accounts.name: asset_fee_tier
docs: canonical bump; empty data == no tier, fall back to `default_fee_bps`.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_token_account
docs: Canonical ATA(fee_config.fee_recipient, source_mint); required iff the
resolved fee is positive. Option is sound here because the failure
direction is closed: omitting it blocks the deposit, never the fee.

types.name: AddressBookEntry
docs: Per-address-book-root owner-managed (source_mint, chain, target_token) -> decimals registry.
`target_decimals = 0` is a tombstone/disabled entry, mirroring zeroed EVM TokenInfo.
PDA seeds: ["address_book", address_book_root, source_mint, chain_id.to_le_bytes(), target_token]

fields.name: target_decimals
docs: Decimals of `target_token` on the target chain. Serves three roles:
(a) canonical record for downstream amount math, (b) EVM-parity
existence sentinel, (c) tombstone marker when `0`. Tokens with 0
real decimals are not representable here — not a concern for USDC
and other bridgeable tokens, but worth knowing.

types.name: AddressBookRoot
docs: Owner-managed source address-book namespace. The root account is initialized
explicitly and then committed inside immutable `SourceHandlerData`.

types.name: AssetFeeTier
docs: Per-(app, mint) volume tier (EVM `assetFeeTiers[appId][asset]`).
PDA seeds: ["asset_fee_tier", app_id, mint]

fields.name: threshold
docs: Amount boundary in the mint's native units.

fields.name: below_bps
docs: Fee bps when amount < threshold; <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

fields.name: above_or_equal_bps
docs: Fee bps when amount >= threshold; <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

types.name: DepositPrepared
docs: Emitted by `validate_and_prepare` after funds reach adapter custody. Carries
the routing inputs needed to build the target-specific bridge message.

fields.name: sra_config
docs: SraConfig PDA the deposit was prepared for.

fields.name: source_mint
docs: Source mint that was locked.

fields.name: adapter_program
docs: Allowlisted adapter program for the prepared deposit.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce captured before the prepare handler increments it.

fields.name: input_amount
docs: Gross tokens pulled from the owner ATA into the SRA vault. The amount
forwarded to adapter custody and bridged in the same transaction is
`input_amount - protocol_fee_amount`.

fields.name: protocol_fee_amount
docs: Protocol fee collected on the source (v15). Zero when fees are
disabled globally, the app has no fee config, or the deposit is
sponsored. The EVM `ProtocolFeeApplied` event collapses into this.

fields.name: output_amount
docs: Minimum output amount the destination must honor; enforced here via
the slippage check (floored from the GROSS input, TOB-SRA-5 parity)
and re-honored by the target-specific adapter flow.

fields.name: target_chain_id
docs: Runtime target chain id from `PrepareParams`.

fields.name: target_handler
docs: Opaque 32-byte target handler identifier. EVM handlers are left-padded
addresses; non-EVM targets may use all 32 bytes.

fields.name: target_adapter
docs: Opaque 32-byte target adapter identifier. EVM adapters are left-padded
addresses; non-EVM targets may use all 32 bytes.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Destination account / recipient identifier.

fields.name: app_id
docs: Runtime app identifier from `PrepareParams`.

fields.name: target_token
docs: Per-deposit target token identifier. Stored as raw bytes32 so Solana
pubkeys and other non-EVM ids are not truncated.

fields.name: action_idxs
docs: Action indices selected for the destination execution.

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: Global fee state: admin + the single fee recipient.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Pubkey::default() = none (2-step admin transfer).

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Pubkey::default() = fees disabled globally.

types.name: MintNonce
docs: Persistent nonce per `(sra_config, source_mint)`. The owner-signed deposit
flow will create it lazily and increment it per source-mint deposit.
PDA seeds: ["mint_nonce", sra_config, source_mint]

fields.name: input_amount
docs: Gross deposit; the protocol fee is deducted from this on the source.

fields.name: is_sponsor
docs: Owner-signed assertion that skips the protocol fee.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps_override
docs: `NO_FEE_BPS_OVERRIDE` (u16::MAX) = no override.

types.name: ProtocolFeeConfig
docs: Per-app protocol fee (EVM `protocolFeeConfig[appId]`). The app is the fee
payer, never a payee — all fees go to `FeeConfig.fee_recipient`.
PDA seeds: ["protocol_fee", app_id]

fields.name: default_fee_bps
docs: Fallback when no asset tier matches; <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

fields.name: allow_override
docs: Honor a per-deposit bps override (EVM `allowOverride`).

types.name: SourceHandlerData
docs: Owner-installed source policy. Committed at SRA install via
`handler_data_hash` (folded into the SRA's PDA identity) and re-supplied,
then re-authenticated, on every deposit. The routing tuple
(`target_chain_id` / `target_handler` / `target_adapter` / `recipient` /
`app_id` / `target_token`) is part of the immutable identity, mirroring the
EVM `RouteConfig` that `trigger()` reads from storage and a caller cannot
redirect (see `sra-stx/src/handler/SRAHandler.sol`). Every deposit must echo
this exact routing in `PrepareParams`; `validate_and_prepare` rejects any
divergence. Changing the route means a new SRA at a new address — the Solana
analogue of the EVM clone-proxy + `_onInstall` model.

types.name: SraConfig
docs: One source-side SRA per `(owner, final_handler, handler_data_hash, salt)`.
PDA seeds: ["sra", owner, config_hash, salt]
config_hash = keccak256(owner ‖ final_handler ‖ handler_data_hash)
